title: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Underwriting Rules for Rated Drivers, Driver Removal and Named Driver Exclusion
content:
Every licensed household member and every regular operator of a vehicle scheduled on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy must be either a rated driver or an excluded driver on the policy.

## 1. Policy status

The policy status must be bound or in force when a driver change is processed. This covers adding, excluding and removing drivers. The status is read from the policy record of the policy being changed.

## 2. Reporting a new household driver

A household member who becomes licensed or moves into the household must be reported within the package's household driver report window (30 calendar days on every package). The driver is added effective the date the member became licensed or moved in when reported within that window, and effective the date of the request when reported later. The date the member joined the household is taken from that driver's record.

Hypothetical: a member who moved in on day 0 and is reported on day 30 is added effective day 0. If reported on day 31, the member is added effective the request date.

## 3. Adding a rated driver

A driver may be added only while the policy has fewer rated drivers than its package's rated-driver maximum. The add is also subject to the package eligibility rules, including the license-status conditions.

## 4. Named driver exclusion

- **Availability.** Instead of being rated, a household member may be excluded from all coverage under a named driver exclusion. The exclusion is available only on packages that allow a named driver exclusion.
- **Signature and date.** The named driver exclusion form must be signed by the named insured before the exclusion is processed. The exclusion takes effect on the date the form was signed, or on a later date the named insured chose on the form.
- **Effect.** An excluded driver has no coverage of any kind while driving any vehicle on the policy. An excluded driver cannot be the subject of a financial-responsibility filing, and is removed from all surcharge and discount counts.
- **Retired clause.** The former clause under which a named driver exclusion was processed only when a signed named driver exclusion request existed for that driver on that policy is **no longer in force**, superseded by the current basis.

| Package allows a named driver exclusion | Exclusion of a household member |
|---|---|
| Yes | Available, by the named insured's signed form |
| No | Not available |

## 5. Removal and the named insured

- A driver who has moved out of the household, or who has died, is removed effective the date of the move or of death.
- The named insured cannot be excluded or removed by endorsement.

superseded_clauses: A named driver exclusion is processed only when a signed named driver exclusion request exists for that driver on that policy.
